summary: Request: restore network printing and temporary guest printing queue for 3rd-floor multipurpose room
description:
Issue summary: Multiple teams report inability to print to the network printer in the 3rd-floor multipurpose room (PR-3F-02) after recent network changes.

Impact: Low-to-medium operational friction for events and ad-hoc posters; delays for marketing and events teams when on-site printing is required. Not customer-facing but affects scheduled internal demos and hiring event prep.

Environment: Office network (corp-wired + corp-wifi), building Palo Alto HQ, printer model: HP LaserJet Managed PR-3F-02. Changes were made to guest VLAN and printer ACLs during the August network maintenance window.

Steps to reproduce: 1) Connect laptop to corp-wifi on 3rd floor. 2) Attempt to add network printer by IP or via corp-print discovery. 3) Send test print job. Result: print job stalls in queue with authentication error or "permission denied" on the printer management page.

Observed logs/errors: Printer web UI returns "403: Forbidden" for print job POSTs; Windows clients show "Need credentials" popups. No obvious errors in captive portal logs.

Request / desired outcome: 1) Restore a temporary guest printing queue or allow corp-wifi subnet 10.14.3.0/24 to access PR-3F-02 while we audit printer ACLs. 2) Create a short-lived service account/queue named "office-print-temp" with RBAC limited to events/people-ops. 3) Document the change in Confluence and notify facilities and events teams.

Acceptance criteria: - Test print from at least two different OSes (macOS, Windows) succeeds. - Change scoped to a short maintenance window and rolled back automatically after 30 days (or until facilities confirm permanent change). - Confluence page updated with instructions for event hosts.
comments: Aisha Patel: Reporting this after two separate events failed to print. Can infra help with a temporary queue?
Ethan Kim: Looking into ACLs and the recent VLAN changes. I can schedule a quick maintenance window tomorrow morning.
Facilities (Lina Morales): We need the queue for a candidate event on 2025-08-14. Can this be prioritized?
Ethan Kim: Marking as P3 but targeting a short window 2025-08-15 07:00-08:00 PT. Will post rollback plan.
Aisha Patel: Thanks — please ping events and marketing once fixed.
